notes.subject: fix(assistant): restyle the Remembered strip and theme the activity shelf
notes.summary: The Assistant's Remembered lines above the composer get a restyled look with a clearer Undo button, and the activity shelf background now follows the theme.

notes.subject: feat(cli): add /condense and shared per-model condense thresholds
notes.summary: The standalone CLI gains /condense and /condense threshold, sharing per-model condense thresholds with VS Code, backed by new SDK condense APIs (manual trigger, sessions.condense, host.condenseSession, condense.thresholds).
